name: Sanyo Electric Railway Co.,Ltd.
summary: Sanyo Electric Railway Co.,Ltd. engages in transportation and real estate businesses in Japan. The company operates through Transportation Segment; Distribution Industry; Real Estate Business; Rental Service; And Other Segments. It is involved in operating trains, buses, taxis, etc.; sale of products mainly in the department store business; leasing and sale of buildings and land; and restaurant business.
